articles.title: AMD 1Q26: How Far Can It Go
articles.claim_summary: AMD maintains a BUY rating with a US$564 price target, supported by accelerating AI infrastructure demand, validated MI450/Helios hyperscaler deployments, and rising server CPU TAM, despite near-term risks from pricing pressure, capex cyclicality, and competition with Nvidia. 1Q26 results showed revenue of US$10.3bn, 53% gross margin, US$1.5bn operating income, US$1.4bn net income, and US$0.84 diluted EPS.

findings.title: Nvidia, AMD, Dell sink in global tech rout on AI funding worries - CNBC
findings.reason: The report indicates that 'Nvidia, AMD, Dell sink in global tech rout on AI funding worries', contradicting and materially complicating the claim that AMD is supported by accelerating AI infrastructure demand.

articles.title: Micron 4Q26 Earnings Update: This Cycle Could Be Different; Maintain BUY
articles.claim_summary: Micron's price target has been raised to USD 1,761 alongside a reiterated BUY rating following record quarterly financial results and elevated guidance. The thesis posits that surging AI-driven demand for High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and enterprise SSDs, combined with constrained memory supply growth and expanding customer agreements, will sustain earnings expansion and moderate the traditional cyclical downturn.

findings.title: Memory stocks are getting hammered. China and a 2029 oversupply are the big worries - CNBC
findings.reason: The report highlights that 'Memory stocks are getting hammered' due to concerns that 'China and a 2029 oversupply are the big worries.' This directly undercuts the claim's thesis that constrained memory supply growth will moderate the cyclical downturn and sustain earnings expansion.
